Below is the FAQ content to load.

What is Harbor Quill?
My public mission behind Harbor Quill is to support my household’s recovery after a fraudulent property investment collapsed. The launch uses my memoir novella as an unlimited-mint NFT ebook on Base and applies my first-of-its-kind CORA (Community Outreach Response Automation).
Readers who share it can immediately earn commissions and prizes without a set limit. If the model succeeds, it will grow into ArchiveLedger, a community-owned platform serving every independent creator.

How do buyers earn money?
1. Receive a $10 instant commission whenever somebody mints with your referral code
2. Get Small & Big Block prize tickets each time a mint uses your code
3. Qualify in the future for an ArchiveLedger governance token distributed to buyers, affiliates, and tippers

How do referrals work?
The permanent referral code for each NFT is its token serial.
Either of these methods works:
→ Share the complete link
→ Simply tell someone to “use referral 423”
A mint made with your code immediately gives you $10 plus Small & Big Block prize tickets for the active blocks.

Where do I find my referral code?
Use your token serial. It appears:
- In the on-chain metadata for your NFT
- On your Dashboard after minting
- Optionally, in your confirmation email

### What are Small Block and Big Block prizes?
After roughly ~2,400 sales from mints and secondary transactions, Small Block draws 8 × $900.
After approximately ~180,000 sales from those same sources, Big Block draws 9 × $6,000.
Every sale continues funding the pools forever.

### How are winners selected?
Selection uses Chainlink VRF, making the process fully on-chain, provably fair, and verifiable on Basescan.

### What are Small & Big Block prize tickets?
They are one-time entries for the active Small Block and Big Block draws. A successful referral earns 4 Small + 3 Big tickets.
Tickets expire after their block is drawn; referrals made afterward count toward the following blocks.

### How do I claim my rewards?
- $10 commissions → transferred automatically to your wallet
- Prize wins → published on the Winners page and claimable with one click at <http://harborquill.example|https://harborquill.example/>

### What are badges?
Your NFT receives on-chain badges at referral milestones of 5, 25, 125, 500+.
For now, they are cosmetic and provide leaderboard flex. Later, they may enable token-gated chats, discounts, airdrops, DAO weight, and similar benefits.

### Can I mint with fiat (credit card)?
Yes. Transak accepts cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay, so minting requires neither cryptocurrency nor a wallet.

### Do I need a wallet to participate?
Only if you want affiliate commissions paid out or to trade the NFT later.

### What blockchain is this on?
It runs on Base (Ethereum Layer 2), which is fast, inexpensive, and Coinbase-backed.

### Are there any hidden fees?
No. A mint costs exactly $30, while secondary sales include a clearly shown $48 flat royalty.

### What happens if I sell my NFT?
The buyer receives the book, your original token serial as their referral code, and all badges you earned. Expired prize tickets remain expired.

### How do I share my referral link/code?
From the Dashboard, copy either the full link or your token serial and tell people to “use referral 423”.

### Is this a scam or pyramid scheme?
No. It is single-level only, has unlimited supply, and its full source is verified on Basescan. I receive exactly $8 from every mint and secondary sale forever.

### How do I contact support?
Discord will not launch until there is real traction.
Until then, send a DM to @HarborQuill on X or email elias@harborquill.example. I respond personally and quickly.

For any remaining questions, DM @HarborQuill on X or write to elias@harborquill.example; I’m happy to help.

Once this content is loaded, the work is complete. The site will be surgically clean and difficult to misunderstand, so launch whenever you are ready—I’ll be available as soon as it goes live.
